meta.title: Kingside Trap
meta.description: Does the light of victory lie behind the counterattack, or is it just a deeper trap?

units.rawText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.
units.displayText: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

spans.text: Sanctifier Watchtower 05.

units.rawText: A ringtone blares continuously, echoing through the vast expanse of the watchtower's summit with relentless insistence.
units.displayText: A ringtone blares continuously, echoing through the vast expanse of the watchtower's summit with relentless insistence.

spans.text: A ringtone blares continuously, echoing through the vast expanse of the watchtower's summit with relentless insistence.

units.rawText: Do you always have your notifications on this volume, Professor? I can barely think with all this noise.
units.displayText: Do you always have your notifications on this volume, Professor? I can barely think with all this noise.

spans.text: Do you always have your notifications on this volume, Professor? I can barely think with all this noise.

units.rawText: Perhaps I'm just popular.
units.displayText: Perhaps I'm just popular.

spans.text: Perhaps I'm just popular.

units.rawText: Wouldn't you also agree that this sounds a bit like a victory theme?
units.displayText: Wouldn't you also agree that this sounds a bit like a victory theme?

spans.text: Wouldn't you also agree that this sounds a bit like a victory theme?

units.rawText: Eucharist mulls over it for a moment, picking up the black queen again as she half-heartedly peeks at the jellyfish still lurking in the corner of the room.
units.displayText: Eucharist mulls over it for a moment, picking up the black queen again as she half-heartedly peeks at the jellyfish still lurking in the corner of the room.

spans.text: Eucharist mulls over it for a moment, picking up the black queen again as she half-heartedly peeks at the jellyfish still lurking in the corner of the room.

units.rawText: Has merely restoring communications instilled this degree of confidence in you, Professor?
units.displayText: Has merely restoring communications instilled this degree of confidence in you, Professor?

spans.text: Has merely restoring communications instilled this degree of confidence in you, Professor?

units.rawText: The better half of the game is yet to come. I'd advise against popping your champagne bottles before the dust settles, Professor. The odds still favor me.
units.displayText: The better half of the game is yet to come. I'd advise against popping your champagne bottles before the dust settles, Professor. The odds still favor me.

spans.text: The better half of the game is yet to come. I'd advise against popping your champagne bottles before the dust settles, Professor. The odds still favor me.

units.rawText: The black queen moves on the board again. Meticulously protected by the remaining pieces, it formed a part of a formidable citadel.
units.displayText: The black queen moves on the board again. Meticulously protected by the remaining pieces, it formed a part of a formidable citadel.

spans.text: The black queen moves on the board again. Meticulously protected by the remaining pieces, it formed a part of a formidable citadel.

units.rawText: Is that so?
units.displayText: Is that so?

spans.text: Is that so?

units.rawText: I move my knight forward, preparing to attack the queen.
units.displayText: I move my knight forward, preparing to attack the queen.

spans.text: I move my knight forward, preparing to attack the queen.

units.rawText: What if there were players in this game besides you and I?
units.displayText: What if there were players in this game besides you and I?

spans.text: What if there were players in this game besides you and I?

units.rawText: Oh? Are you awaiting some Sanctifier reinforcements?
units.displayText: Oh? Are you awaiting some Sanctifier reinforcements?

spans.text: Oh? Are you awaiting some Sanctifier reinforcements?

units.rawText: The Reverse Babylon Tower has already responded. The tribunal has decided your fate. Lord Eosphorus assembles a force to hunt you down as we speak.
units.displayText: The Reverse Babylon Tower has already responded. The tribunal has decided your fate. Lord Eosphorus assembles a force to hunt you down as we speak.

spans.text: The Reverse Babylon Tower has already responded. The tribunal has decided your fate. Lord Eosphorus assembles a force to hunt you down as we speak.

units.rawText: Your idyllic days are at an end, Eucharist.
units.displayText: Your idyllic days are at an end, Eucharist.

spans.text: Your idyllic days are at an end, Eucharist.

units.rawText: See, when one grasps the key to the problem, what follows becomes trivial.
units.displayText: See, when one grasps the key to the problem, what follows becomes trivial.

spans.text: See, when one grasps the key to the problem, what follows becomes trivial.

units.rawText: ...A good move indeed. Let me think... what should my next move be?
units.displayText: ...A good move indeed. Let me think... what should my next move be?

spans.text: ...A good move indeed. Let me think... what should my next move be?

units.rawText: Eucharist continues to casually rock her legs back and forth as if Faith's announcement was a mere whisper in the wind.
units.displayText: Eucharist continues to casually rock her legs back and forth as if Faith's announcement was a mere whisper in the wind.

spans.text: Eucharist continues to casually rock her legs back and forth as if Faith's announcement was a mere whisper in the wind.

units.rawText: It's not like I mind continuing this game, but shouldn't you cut your losses while you can?
units.displayText: It's not like I mind continuing this game, but shouldn't you cut your losses while you can?

spans.text: It's not like I mind continuing this game, but shouldn't you cut your losses while you can?

units.rawText: If you leave with your "queen" intact, perhaps you still have a chance.
units.displayText: If you leave with your "queen" intact, perhaps you still have a chance.

spans.text: If you leave with your "queen" intact, perhaps you still have a chance.

units.rawText: Didn't I tell you earlier? When it presents itself, such a good sport cannot be cut short by mere outside resistance.
units.displayText: Didn't I tell you earlier? When it presents itself, such a good sport cannot be cut short by mere outside resistance.

spans.text: Didn't I tell you earlier? When it presents itself, such a good sport cannot be cut short by mere outside resistance.

units.rawText: Ah, I've got it!
units.displayText: Ah, I've got it!

spans.text: Ah, I've got it!

units.rawText: Eucharist picks up a black rook on a corner of the board, pressing on towards the white side of the board again.
units.displayText: Eucharist picks up a black rook on a corner of the board, pressing on towards the white side of the board again.

spans.text: Eucharist picks up a black rook on a corner of the board, pressing on towards the white side of the board again.

units.rawText: Almost forgot I had this piece here.
units.displayText: Almost forgot I had this piece here.

spans.text: Almost forgot I had this piece here.

units.rawText: I'm not one to stay on the defensive. If you want those two pieces, Professor, I don't see why you can't have them.
units.displayText: I'm not one to stay on the defensive. If you want those two pieces, Professor, I don't see why you can't have them.

spans.text: I'm not one to stay on the defensive. If you want those two pieces, Professor, I don't see why you can't have them.

units.rawText: It's far more interesting to attack on the battlefield, after all.
units.displayText: It's far more interesting to attack on the battlefield, after all.

spans.text: It's far more interesting to attack on the battlefield, after all.

units.rawText: Eucharist's hand finds the game clock once more, and my timer continues. Her countenance remains leisurely, and doubts form in my mind.
units.displayText: Eucharist's hand finds the game clock once more, and my timer continues. Her countenance remains leisurely, and doubts form in my mind.

spans.text: Eucharist's hand finds the game clock once more, and my timer continues. Her countenance remains leisurely, and doubts form in my mind.

units.rawText: It is impossible for her to understand what exactly that ringtone meant, but her reaction was far from what I expected.
units.displayText: It is impossible for her to understand what exactly that ringtone meant, but her reaction was far from what I expected.

spans.text: It is impossible for her to understand what exactly that ringtone meant, but her reaction was far from what I expected.

options.rawText: Think back to before the game started.
options.displayText: Think back to before the game started.

spans.text: Think back to before the game started.

units.rawText: Do you really find the need to be this overbearing? All you've done is disrupt communication channels.
units.displayText: Do you really find the need to be this overbearing? All you've done is disrupt communication channels.

spans.text: Do you really find the need to be this overbearing? All you've done is disrupt communication channels.

units.rawText: Yeah, and? What can you do about it?
units.displayText: Yeah, and? What can you do about it?

spans.text: Yeah, and? What can you do about it?

units.rawText: Observing Eucharist's reaction closely, an answer reveals itself in my heart.
units.displayText: Observing Eucharist's reaction closely, an answer reveals itself in my heart.

spans.text: Observing Eucharist's reaction closely, an answer reveals itself in my heart.

units.rawText: Persicaria, do you hear me? As projected, we have Eucharist where we want her. Is the Oasis ready?
units.displayText: Persicaria, do you hear me? As projected, we have Eucharist where we want her. Is the Oasis ready?

spans.text: Persicaria, do you hear me? As projected, we have Eucharist where we want her. Is the Oasis ready?

units.rawText: Wha...!
units.displayText: Wha...!

spans.text: Wha...!

units.rawText: Eucharist's pupils subconsciously shrivel as I lower my communications terminal.
units.displayText: Eucharist's pupils subconsciously shrivel as I lower my communications terminal.

spans.text: Eucharist's pupils subconsciously shrivel as I lower my communications terminal.

units.rawText: Looks like I was right. The Oasis hasn't fallen yet. Otherwise, you wouldn't be this nervous, right?
units.displayText: Looks like I was right. The Oasis hasn't fallen yet. Otherwise, you wouldn't be this nervous, right?

spans.text: Looks like I was right. The Oasis hasn't fallen yet. Otherwise, you wouldn't be this nervous, right?

units.rawText: Tch... hah. Haha, truly brilliant, Professor.
units.displayText: Tch... hah. Haha, truly brilliant, Professor.

spans.text: Tch... hah. Haha, truly brilliant, Professor.

units.rawText: My capacity as a commander is nearly fully restored, and the Reverse Babylon Tower moves to act.
units.displayText: My capacity as a commander is nearly fully restored, and the Reverse Babylon Tower moves to act.

spans.text: My capacity as a commander is nearly fully restored, and the Reverse Babylon Tower moves to act.

units.rawText: Compared to then, Eucharist is inexplicably composed.
units.displayText: Compared to then, Eucharist is inexplicably composed.

spans.text: Compared to then, Eucharist is inexplicably composed.

units.rawText: It's your turn, Professor.
units.displayText: It's your turn, Professor.

spans.text: It's your turn, Professor.

options.rawText: Capture the piece as you originally planned.
options.displayText: Capture the piece as you originally planned.

spans.text: Capture the piece as you originally planned.

options.rawText: Think of a method to fend off Eucharist's attack.
options.displayText: Think of a method to fend off Eucharist's attack.

spans.text: Think of a method to fend off Eucharist's attack.

units.rawText: I reach towards my knight, planning to capture my opponent's bishop as I previously planned—
units.displayText: I reach towards my knight, planning to capture my opponent's bishop as I previously planned—

spans.text: I reach towards my knight, planning to capture my opponent's bishop as I previously planned—

units.rawText: Are you sure you want to do that, Professor?
units.displayText: Are you sure you want to do that, Professor?

spans.text: Are you sure you want to do that, Professor?

units.rawText: I turn to another part of the battlefield to ponder on the black rook, trying to infer Eucharist's goals.
units.displayText: I turn to another part of the battlefield to ponder on the black rook, trying to infer Eucharist's goals.

spans.text: I turn to another part of the battlefield to ponder on the black rook, trying to infer Eucharist's goals.

units.rawText: Intent on dealing with this rook first, hmm?
units.displayText: Intent on dealing with this rook first, hmm?

spans.text: Intent on dealing with this rook first, hmm?

units.rawText: If I were you, I'd be worried if I was biting off more than I can chew~
units.displayText: If I were you, I'd be worried if I was biting off more than I can chew~

spans.text: If I were you, I'd be worried if I was biting off more than I can chew~

units.rawText: Just what are her goals... or rather—
units.displayText: Just what are her goals... or rather—

spans.text: Just what are her goals... or rather—

units.rawText: Has she already accomplished them?
units.displayText: Has she already accomplished them?

spans.text: Has she already accomplished them?

units.rawText: A few moments ago.
units.displayText: A few moments ago.

spans.text: A few moments ago.

units.rawText: Null Area, the Oasis' Backup Communications Node 04.
units.displayText: Null Area, the Oasis' Backup Communications Node 04.

spans.text: Null Area, the Oasis' Backup Communications Node 04.

units.rawText: Done—zo!
units.displayText: Done—zo!

spans.text: Done—zo!

units.rawText: Never imagined that the core instruments in these nodes would be as intact as they were, considering how banged up they were on the outside.
units.displayText: Never imagined that the core instruments in these nodes would be as intact as they were, considering how banged up they were on the outside.

spans.text: Never imagined that the core instruments in these nodes would be as intact as they were, considering how banged up they were on the outside.

units.rawText: Yeah, rather... things are going too smoothly.
units.displayText: Yeah, rather... things are going too smoothly.

spans.text: Yeah, rather... things are going too smoothly.

units.rawText: Well, you can't get easy work whenever you want it. Where are we going next, Lind?
units.displayText: Well, you can't get easy work whenever you want it. Where are we going next, Lind?

spans.text: Well, you can't get easy work whenever you want it. Where are we going next, Lind?

units.rawText: Your career as a communications techie is at an end, I'm afraid. There's nothing left to fix.
units.displayText: Your career as a communications techie is at an end, I'm afraid. There's nothing left to fix.

spans.text: Your career as a communications techie is at an end, I'm afraid. There's nothing left to fix.

units.rawText: Lind gives Havoc a look at the message on her screen.
units.displayText: Lind gives Havoc a look at the message on her screen.

spans.text: Lind gives Havoc a look at the message on her screen.

units.rawText: Message successfully sent. Their comms are back.
units.displayText: Message successfully sent. Their comms are back.

spans.text: Message successfully sent. Their comms are back.

units.rawText: That fast?
units.displayText: That fast?

spans.text: That fast?

units.rawText: Yes, probably because the Oasis also sent their own people to repair communications.
units.displayText: Yes, probably because the Oasis also sent their own people to repair communications.

spans.text: Yes, probably because the Oasis also sent their own people to repair communications.

units.rawText: Makes sense. They're the nerves of an army on the battlefield. They're right to be in a rush.
units.displayText: Makes sense. They're the nerves of an army on the battlefield. They're right to be in a rush.

spans.text: Makes sense. They're the nerves of an army on the battlefield. They're right to be in a rush.

units.rawText: Phew, we can finally get outta this purple and icky place... so what about it, go to the Oasis?
units.displayText: Phew, we can finally get outta this purple and icky place... so what about it, go to the Oasis?

spans.text: Phew, we can finally get outta this purple and icky place... so what about it, go to the Oasis?

units.rawText: Well, you know, things arrive whether or not we want them to. I know you don't want to see Persicaria, but—
units.displayText: Well, you know, things arrive whether or not we want them to. I know you don't want to see Persicaria, but—

spans.text: Well, you know, things arrive whether or not we want them to. I know you don't want to see Persicaria, but—

units.rawText: Havoc! Something's wrong!
units.displayText: Havoc! Something's wrong!

spans.text: Havoc! Something's wrong!

units.rawText: The rest of the squad isn't responding!
units.displayText: The rest of the squad isn't responding!

spans.text: The rest of the squad isn't responding!

units.rawText: What?!
units.displayText: What?!

spans.text: What?!

units.rawText: Havoc flips open her terminal in a hurry.
units.displayText: Havoc flips open her terminal in a hurry.

spans.text: Havoc flips open her terminal in a hurry.

units.rawText: We can still pin down their coordinates. They're still close.
units.displayText: We can still pin down their coordinates. They're still close.

spans.text: We can still pin down their coordinates. They're still close.

units.rawText: Lind glares at her terminal, her expression growing more intense by the second.
units.displayText: Lind glares at her terminal, her expression growing more intense by the second.

spans.text: Lind glares at her terminal, her expression growing more intense by the second.

units.rawText: It doesn't seem like a communications problem...
units.displayText: It doesn't seem like a communications problem...

spans.text: It doesn't seem like a communications problem...

units.rawText: I'll go look for them!
units.displayText: I'll go look for them!

spans.text: I'll go look for them!

units.rawText: Wait! Don't!
units.displayText: Wait! Don't!

spans.text: Wait! Don't!

units.rawText: Before Lind finishes speaking, Havoc's footsteps come to a halt.
units.displayText: Before Lind finishes speaking, Havoc's footsteps come to a halt.

spans.text: Before Lind finishes speaking, Havoc's footsteps come to a halt.

units.rawText: Why are you so willing to listen all of a sudden? We don't know what they've run into or why they haven't sent any signal...
units.displayText: Why are you so willing to listen all of a sudden? We don't know what they've run into or why they haven't sent any signal...

spans.text: Why are you so willing to listen all of a sudden? We don't know what they've run into or why they haven't sent any signal...

units.rawText: ...Havoc?
units.displayText: ...Havoc?

spans.text: ...Havoc?

units.rawText: Havoc doesn't answer. That dreaded purple liquid climbs up her body, silent in its motion.
units.displayText: Havoc doesn't answer. That dreaded purple liquid climbs up her body, silent in its motion.

spans.text: Havoc doesn't answer. That dreaded purple liquid climbs up her body, silent in its motion.

units.rawText: Look out... Entropic liquid...
units.displayText: Look out... Entropic liquid...

spans.text: Look out... Entropic liquid...

units.rawText: Havoc struggles to utter a few scarce words. Almost simultaneously, countless translucent Entropics emerge from the liquid, attaching to her body.
units.displayText: Havoc struggles to utter a few scarce words. Almost simultaneously, countless translucent Entropics emerge from the liquid, attaching to her body.

spans.text: Havoc struggles to utter a few scarce words. Almost simultaneously, countless translucent Entropics emerge from the liquid, attaching to her body.

units.rawText: Havoc!
units.displayText: Havoc!

spans.text: Havoc!

units.rawText: Don't... come any closer!
units.displayText: Don't... come any closer!

spans.text: Don't... come any closer!

units.rawText: Ignoring the warning, Lind rushes forward, deftly removing the Entropics from Havoc's body. She positions herself underneath Havoc, catching her as she falls.
units.displayText: Ignoring the warning, Lind rushes forward, deftly removing the Entropics from Havoc's body. She positions herself underneath Havoc, catching her as she falls.

spans.text: Ignoring the warning, Lind rushes forward, deftly removing the Entropics from Havoc's body. She positions herself underneath Havoc, catching her as she falls.

units.rawText: Gah... huff...
units.displayText: Gah... huff...

spans.text: Gah... huff...

units.rawText: Oi! Get a grip! Where's the Anti-Entropization Serum?!
units.displayText: Oi! Get a grip! Where's the Anti-Entropization Serum?!

spans.text: Oi! Get a grip! Where's the Anti-Entropization Serum?!

units.rawText: Inner side of the instruments...
units.displayText: Inner side of the instruments...

spans.text: Inner side of the instruments...

units.rawText: Cough... and your impulsive ass was telling me to not be so rash... wow, your hands are cold...
units.displayText: Cough... and your impulsive ass was telling me to not be so rash... wow, your hands are cold...

spans.text: Cough... and your impulsive ass was telling me to not be so rash... wow, your hands are cold...

units.rawText: Shut up and focus on holding the infection back. If the Entropics wanted me, they'd have gone for me long ago.
units.displayText: Shut up and focus on holding the infection back. If the Entropics wanted me, they'd have gone for me long ago.

spans.text: Shut up and focus on holding the infection back. If the Entropics wanted me, they'd have gone for me long ago.

units.rawText: The purple spread on Havoc's body ceases as the serum enters her system, but no color returns to her face.
units.displayText: The purple spread on Havoc's body ceases as the serum enters her system, but no color returns to her face.

spans.text: The purple spread on Havoc's body ceases as the serum enters her system, but no color returns to her face.

units.rawText: The jellyfish-like Entropics surface one by one from the liquid, slowly encircling the pair.
units.displayText: The jellyfish-like Entropics surface one by one from the liquid, slowly encircling the pair.

spans.text: The jellyfish-like Entropics surface one by one from the liquid, slowly encircling the pair.

units.rawText: What the hell... no wonder it went so smoothly, it was a trap all along...
units.displayText: What the hell... no wonder it went so smoothly, it was a trap all along...

spans.text: What the hell... no wonder it went so smoothly, it was a trap all along...

units.rawText: No good... they sucked away my operands...
units.displayText: No good... they sucked away my operands...

spans.text: No good... they sucked away my operands...

units.rawText: I don't know why you're not affected, but you need to get out of here...
units.displayText: I don't know why you're not affected, but you need to get out of here...

spans.text: I don't know why you're not affected, but you need to get out of here...

units.rawText: You say that as if you don't weigh as much as a bag of bricks.
units.displayText: You say that as if you don't weigh as much as a bag of bricks.

spans.text: You say that as if you don't weigh as much as a bag of bricks.

units.rawText: ...Lind, don't worry about me—
units.displayText: ...Lind, don't worry about me—

spans.text: ...Lind, don't worry about me—

units.rawText: I know what you're thinking. If you die on me here, I'm going to kill you.
units.displayText: I know what you're thinking. If you die on me here, I'm going to kill you.

spans.text: I know what you're thinking. If you die on me here, I'm going to kill you.

units.rawText: Cough... you need to listen to what you're saying sometimes, you know...
units.displayText: Cough... you need to listen to what you're saying sometimes, you know...

spans.text: Cough... you need to listen to what you're saying sometimes, you know...

units.rawText: Fighting off these Entropics is much easier than dealing with those guys from the Oasis!
units.displayText: Fighting off these Entropics is much easier than dealing with those guys from the Oasis!

spans.text: Fighting off these Entropics is much easier than dealing with those guys from the Oasis!

units.rawText: Can you still walk? I'll deal with these Entropics! You need to at least go give everyone a shot of the serum!
units.displayText: Can you still walk? I'll deal with these Entropics! You need to at least go give everyone a shot of the serum!

spans.text: Can you still walk? I'll deal with these Entropics! You need to at least go give everyone a shot of the serum!

units.rawText: Wow, that's a big ask...
units.displayText: Wow, that's a big ask...

spans.text: Wow, that's a big ask...

units.rawText: Lind lifts Havoc off the ground with one mechanical arm as they slowly make their way toward their squadmates, remaining vigilant of their surroundings.
units.displayText: Lind lifts Havoc off the ground with one mechanical arm as they slowly make their way toward their squadmates, remaining vigilant of their surroundings.

spans.text: Lind lifts Havoc off the ground with one mechanical arm as they slowly make their way toward their squadmates, remaining vigilant of their surroundings.

units.rawText: Suddenly, an ethereal song bursts around them, light and melancholic, akin to an elegy.
units.displayText: Suddenly, an ethereal song bursts around them, light and melancholic, akin to an elegy.

spans.text: Suddenly, an ethereal song bursts around them, light and melancholic, akin to an elegy.

units.rawText: <color=purple>For the dearly departed, for what we've lost...</color>
units.displayText: For the dearly departed, for what we've lost...

spans.text: For the dearly departed, for what we've lost...

units.rawText: <color=purple>Sing and make merry, to your heart's content...</color>
units.displayText: Sing and make merry, to your heart's content...

spans.text: Sing and make merry, to your heart's content...

units.rawText: The jellyfish sway in tune to the song as if they were set pieces at a grand ball.
units.displayText: The jellyfish sway in tune to the song as if they were set pieces at a grand ball.

spans.text: The jellyfish sway in tune to the song as if they were set pieces at a grand ball.

units.rawText: The Entropic liquid coalesces into wave after wave, growing larger and larger. The jellyfish at the center of the promenade contort and transform, gradually assuming another form—
units.displayText: The Entropic liquid coalesces into wave after wave, growing larger and larger. The jellyfish at the center of the promenade contort and transform, gradually assuming another form—

spans.text: The Entropic liquid coalesces into wave after wave, growing larger and larger. The jellyfish at the center of the promenade contort and transform, gradually assuming another form—

units.rawText: <color=purple>Come, one and all...</color>
units.displayText: Come, one and all...

spans.text: Come, one and all...

units.rawText: <color=purple>We shall reassemble, here in this place...</color>
units.displayText: We shall reassemble, here in this place...

spans.text: We shall reassemble, here in this place...

units.rawText: But seeing as you're genuinely asking me for once, I'll hold out for a bit longer!
units.displayText: But seeing as you're genuinely asking me for once, I'll hold out for a bit longer!

spans.text: But seeing as you're genuinely asking me for once, I'll hold out for a bit longer!
